note:
THE FRONT LAW IS THE PART TO READ FIRST, because it settles the ethic the rest runs on: THE FINISHED BODY BELONGS TO THE WOMAN. The clinic builds completely and WILL NOT IMPOVERISH A COHERENT DESIGN because useful anatomy may later be used enthusiastically or indecently. A TRAIT’S FORESEEABLE MISUSE BY AN ENTHUSIASTIC WOMAN IS NOT A DESIGN FAULT, and the record does not follow her into what she does with it.

THE MATH HARDENED. WHR classes at Balanced, Pronounced and Extreme between 0.60 and 0.70. Even whole inches, rounding DOWN between, never through the floor. AND THE SEPARATION CEILING MOVED FROM 0.05 TO 0.10, with the reason stated: 0.05 behaved like a requirement for bust and hips to nearly match, REJECTING COHERENT BUST-LIGHT AND BOTTOM-HEAVY HOURGLASSES and pressuring specialist anatomy to compensate for arithmetic. IT IS PERMISSION, NOT A TARGET.

EIGHT BUILDS, EACH WITH A PHYSICAL ROOT: Athletic, Huntress, Seductress, Ethereal, Opulent, Voltaic, Valkyrie, Dancer. ONE GOVERNMENT PER WOMAN, three Native Traits each, adoptable across boundaries in Clinic notation WITHOUT reclassifying anybody.

AND THE DISTINCTION THE ARCHIVE MOST NEEDED: ETHEREAL’S AFTERIMAGE IS REAL ANATOMY STILL RESOLVING; VOLTAIC’S TRACKING AFTERIMAGE IS AN ERROR OF THE OBSERVER’S EYE. Two similar words, two completely different mechanisms, and the Archive would have conflated them inside a week.
